summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing board approval and shareholder adoption of a 1-for-10 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, par value rising from US$0.0001 to US$0.001. The board passed written resolutions on October 16, 2026, recommending the consolidation; shareholders holding a majority of votes entitled to be cast approved via written resolutions circulated and mailed the same day, satisfying Articles 8.1(b) and 11.16. No fractional shares will be issued, with entitlements rounded up. Authorized capital becomes US$500,000 split into 450,000,000 Class A and 50,000,000 Class B shares; the market effective date will be announced separately. Watch for the effective date and any post-consolidation price or liquidity adjustments.
